title: Supergirl
plot_overview: After a ruthless enemy strikes close to home, a troubled young hero reluctantly joins an unlikely companion on a dangerous journey across the stars. Their quest for justice and revenge becomes a colorful, action-filled adventure involving powerful foes, unexpected allies, and a race to save someone important to them.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like eccentric, action-heavy superhero adventures such as The Marvels or The Flash; Not for you if you want focused storytelling, subtle emotion, or consistently grounded characters.
review_summary: Pros: energetic action; colorful visuals; lively humor | Cons: uneven story; thin characters; tonal shifts
